title: OpenDepthMap GeoParquet 1.1 Sounding Record Schema
description: Canonical full-resolution bathymetric sounding record contract stored in GeoParquet 1.1.0 archives (OGC:CRS84 / EPSG:4326). Supplemental bathymetric reference only; not certified for primary marine navigation.

sounding_id.description: Monotonic 64-bit sounding sequence number within a track.

device_id.description: Registered vessel or sensor rig UUID.

geometry.description: GeoParquet 1.1 WKB Point geometry in OGC:CRS84 (WGS84 lon, lat).

bbox.x-parquet-type: STRUCT<xmin: FLOAT, ymin: FLOAT, xmax: FLOAT, ymax: FLOAT>
bbox.description: GeoParquet 1.1 bounding box covering struct for Parquet row-group predicate pushdown.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees (replaced by H3 R8 centroid when is_fuzzed is true).

lat.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees (replaced by H3 R8 centroid when is_fuzzed is true).

h3_index_r8.description: H3 spatial index at Resolution 8 (~460 m edge length) used for 150 m shoreline fuzzing.

h3_index_r9.description: H3 spatial index at Resolution 9 (~174 m edge length) for spatial filtering and binning.

is_fuzzed.description: True when exact coordinates were replaced by the enclosing H3 Resolution 8 centroid due to 150 m shoreline/endpoint fuzzing.

raw_depth_m.description: Immutable unreduced transducer depth in meters positive downward.

draft_offset_m.description: Static waterline-to-transducer vertical draft offset in meters.

assumed_sound_speed_ms.description: Assumed acoustic speed of sound configured on the transducer in m/s.

water_temp_c.description: Measured or track-default water temperature in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.description: Measured or track-default water salinity in Practical Salinity Units (0.0 for freshwater).

sv_corrected_depth_m.description: UNESCO (Chen & Millero 1977) sound-velocity corrected transducer depth in meters.

motion_corrected_depth_m.description: Depth below mean instantaneous waterline after draft, lever-arm, pitch/roll slant-range, and heave compensation.

tide_correction_m.description: Water-level height above chart datum in meters subtracted from motion_corrected_depth_m.

reduced_depth_m.description: Final datum-reduced depth in meters positive downward (e.g., MLLW).

pitch_deg.description: Vessel IMU pitch in degrees (positive bow-up).

roll_deg.description: Vessel IMU roll in degrees (positive starboard-down).

heave_m.description: Vessel IMU wave heave in meters (positive upward above mean waterline).

tvu_m.description: Total Vertical Uncertainty at 95% confidence in meters.

thu_m.description: Total Horizontal Uncertainty at 95% confidence in meters.

iho_s44_order.description: Defaults to UNASSESSED_CSB for unverified crowd/recreational uploads; official S-44 orders apply only to verified instrumented surveys.

calibration_tier.description: Transparent calibration completeness indicator for recreational and scientific consumers.

recorded_at_utc.description: Precise UTC timestamp of sounding capture.
